owner_decision.statement: The Owner decided on 2026-10-04 to release 1.5.3. Stable 1.5.0 is published for all 44 fixed-group packages: authenticated registry census on 2026-10-04 observed latest 1.5.0 and rc 1.5.0-rc.2. The historical 1.5.1 and 1.5.2 candidates were never published. Eleven changesets pending on origin/main (nine releasing patches and two test-only) advance the fixed group from 1.5.2 to 1.5.3 under scripts/version-packages.mjs. Publish only with the latest dist-tag and an action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt; preflight latest must remain 1.5.0 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. This decision does not authorize angular-profile 2.0.0 remediation.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified stable 1.5.3 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.5.3, rc remains at 1.5.0-rc.2, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history.
